{"metadata":{"description":"Deep PTC mode for DSH: fixes reporting, asking, reachability, planning and context/token use; plugin-first with official PTC fallback, dynamic preset/tool loading, creative lab, dsh-go screen control and dsh-ops-tested external-tool adaptation.","id":"gh:1436077930","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-deep-ptc-mode","slug":"lishize20040802-rgb/dsh-deep-ptc-mode","topics":["agent-preset","deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","open-source","powershell","prompt-engineering","ptc","wsl"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Deep PTC mode for DSH: fixes reporting, asking, reachability, planning and context/token use; plugin"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"-first with official PTC fallback, dynamic preset/tool loading, creative lab, dsh-go screen control "},{"id":"p1s3","text":"and dsh-ops-tested external-tool adaptation."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Deep PTC mode"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"中文 · MIT · **1.8.2**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"1.7.3 实测汇总 / Test summary
**Reports. Asks. Stays awake. Plans. Stays reachable.**
**Five basics, one"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" mode; everything is a plugin, with the official preset always as the fallback.**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Deep PTC is not another tool bundle. It is a DeepSeek Harness agent preset built around five basic p"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"roblems in model work: working silently without reporting, guessing instead of asking when intent is"},{"id":"p5s3","text":" ambiguous, sleeping and becoming unreachable during a task, not planning or not showing the plan, a"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"nd not using the original PTC preset's concise context plus its unlimited-token prompt."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Those five are handled first by prompts and code. On top of that, following DSH's “everything is a p"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"lugin” philosophy, the preset adds dynamic preset/tool loading, creative-mode tools for building DSH"},{"id":"p6s3","text":" plugins, dsh-go screen-control adaptation, wider shell support, external plugin tool/workflow adapt"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"ation, and a leaner skill/tool loading flow. Deep PTC adds no task tools itself; it provides the int"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"erface that lets a plugin's new tools be discovered, loaded and called."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Not every third-party plugin is guaranteed to fit: the interface is verified for dsh-ops and reused "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"by other plugins, but a plugin still has to support the installed host and publish its tools under t"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"he expected contract."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Five basic problems"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| # | Problem | What Deep PTC does |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| 1 | **Working silently without reporting** | One sentence before every `run_code`; a longer update"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" at milestones; never more than two or three silent tool calls; a short final result with failed too"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"ls and providers. |
| 2 | **Guessing instead of asking** | Meaning belongs to the user, facts to the"},{"id":"p10s4","text":" tools: ask one to three questions with options when names, targets, routes, scope or acceptance cri"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"teria are unclear; look up inspectable facts yourself. The user's answer wins. |
| 3 | **Sleeping or"},{"id":"p10s6","text":" becoming unreachable** | Enforced in code: foreground waits move to the background after 30 s; a us"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"er message hands the waiting command to the background within about 2 s; foreground sleeps over 5 s "},{"id":"p10s8","text":"are refused; job completion wakes the model. |
| 4 | **No plan, or an invisible plan** | Plan by est"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"imated size: act silently under 5 minutes; show the plan and start without approval for 5–20 minutes"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"; show it and wait for approval over 20 minutes. Re-plan when the estimate moves up; the user can re"},{"id":"p10s11","text":"direct at any step. |
| 5 | **Not using the concise context and unlimited-token prompt** | Derive fr"},{"id":"p10s12","text":"om the live official PTC composition, keep the tool catalog compact and load full schemas on demand,"},{"id":"p10s13","text":" and state that this mode spends its token budget on reads, searches, commands and checks rather tha"},{"id":"p10s14","text":"n rationing them. The prompt does not change billing or the real token limit. |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Built for “everything is a plugin”"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### 1. Dynamic preset and tool loading"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Read the running host's official PTC declaration and inherit its rows as they are; only the persona,"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" execution group, reachability guard, job wrapper and question wrapper are replaced. Rebuild only wh"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"en the declaration or settings change (checked every five seconds); fall back to the bundled snapsho"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"t with a warning if it cannot be loaded, parsed or derived. An official upgrade can add tools withou"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"t a release of this preset; existing sessions are not forcibly switched."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### 2. Flexible creative-mode tools"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The plugin lab is off by default. When enabled, it reads the host's creative preset and appends only"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" the rows that mode adds, specifically for building DSH plugins. Module names stay as declared; skil"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"l directories resolve relative to the creative preset file. Lab packages stay in process memory, are"},{"id":"p15s4","text":" not written to the repository, shipped presets, desktop composition or this plugin's source, and ru"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"n only through the host's existing approval. Loading reads the roster and documents only; it never c"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"alls `composedPreset`."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### 3. dsh-go screen-control adaptation"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### 4. Wider execution environments"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### 5. External plugin tool/workflow adaptation (dsh-ops tested)"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Compatibility and development"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Deep PTC is composed at load time from the PTC preset the installed Harness declares (`@deepseek-ai/"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"dsh-web-app/presets/ptc.patch.yml`). Every official row is inherited as-is; Deep PTC replaces only i"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"ts persona text, swaps the two platform-switched shell tools for one isolated execution group, adds "},{"id":"p23s4","text":"the reachability guard, and wraps the official job and question tools. The wrappers and the executio"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"n group never name an official module themselves: they load the module the official row names (and t"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"he shell executors the base deployment declares in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base/cordis.patch.yml`), with t"},{"id":"p23s7","text":"he official options. An official PTC change therefore reaches this mode without a plugin release, an"},{"id":"p23s8","text":"d a removed or renamed upstream module cannot leave a stale row behind. When the chosen execution en"},{"id":"p23s9","text":"vironment cannot be mapped onto the official rows, those rows are kept and the change is logged. If "},{"id":"p23s10","text":"the declaration cannot be resolved, read or parsed, the bundled `lib/preset.json` snapshot is used a"},{"id":"p23s11","text":"s a fallback and the fallback is logged."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Because the declarations are resolved through the host runtime, every host package the plugin import"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"s statically is declared in `peerDependencies` — including `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`. The host rout"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"es those names to the installation for a linked plugin; `npm run check` fails if one is missing, whi"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"ch is what keeps a `link:` installation on the live declaration instead of silently using the fallba"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"ck snapshot. `compatibility.json` records the upstream release the checked fixture was taken from an"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"d its hash; `npm run check` verifies that the bundled fallback still derives the same preset as that"},{"id":"p24s7","text":" fixture and that the inheritance invariants hold. The engines range is an installation floor, not p"},{"id":"p24s8","text":"roof that every future release was tested, so run `npm run check:upstream -- <path>` against a new r"},{"id":"p24s9","text":"elease before trusting it."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
